kinds.behavior: Arc swing or charge in front of you.

kinds.trigger: Contact move with priority > 0 or 'rush' tag
kinds.behavior: Lunge across the screen, damaging everything along the path; repositions you.

kinds.trigger: Status move, target self, raises a stat stage
kinds.behavior: Stacks a stat while active; no damage. Stat engine, never an opener.

kinds.trigger: DEFAULT: any remaining ranged single-target damaging move
kinds.behavior: Fires at nearest enemy and pierces several.

kinds.trigger: Special, ranged, short-range stream/flame/cone tag with status chance
kinds.behavior: Short forward cone of repeated hits with status buildup.
kinds.flags: status chance, cone angle, tick rate

kinds.trigger: Bind/trap flag or wind-swirl tag around the user
kinds.behavior: Orbs revolve around you; constant personal-space defense.

kinds.trigger: Target = all adjacent/all foes, power > 80, or sound/wave tag
Special, power >= 100 with accuracy <= 85, or beam/ray tag
kinds.behavior: Slow, wide, high-damage line piercing its lane.
Travels out and back, hitting both ways.

kinds.trigger: Target = all adjacent, power <= 80, continuous/ground-shake feel
kinds.behavior: Permanent field around you that ticks damage on whatever is nearby.

kinds.trigger: Special, single target, arc/jump tag (Electric, Ghost curse)
kinds.behavior: Jumps from one enemy to the next; strong against packed hordes.

kinds.trigger: Rolling / sustained-movement tag (user keeps moving while attacking)
kinds.behavior: Damaging pools left behind as you move.

kinds.trigger: Entry hazard or trap move (damage placed before the foe arrives)
kinds.behavior: Ground traps that detonate when stepped on.
Strikes called down on nearby enemies; slows what it hits.

kinds.trigger: Summons/places a user-side object (Substitute-type) or status-cast ranged pet
kinds.behavior: Stationary summon that fires on its own.

newKinds.trigger: Status move, target self/ally, restores HP (or regen effect)
newKinds.behavior: Burst heal or timed regen scaled to max HP. Cooldown-gated so it cannot be spammed.

newKinds.trigger: Status move, protects user/side (Protect family, screens, Endure)
newKinds.behavior: Short invulnerability window or damage-reduction shield; screens become a timed % reduction.

newKinds.trigger: Status move, target foe(s), lowers stat or inflicts status
newKinds.behavior: Debuff or crowd-control pulse on nearby enemies: slow, sleep, stun, weaken, confuse.
Persistent zone or weather that changes rules (not damage). Replaces the fake 'terrain' evolutions.
